fusions.name: Carrier's Bite
fusions.desc: Rushes up to 6 tiles to the target and bites for 12 piercing damage, leaving Rot for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Kennel Cough
fusions.desc: Howls a cone of spores 5 tiles long that deals 26 resonating damage to everything in it, with a 40% chance per hit to leave it [Diseased] for 8 seconds. If it hits, you and your allies deal 15% more damage for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Faithful Remains
fusions.desc: The nearest body within 9.5 tiles rises and fights at your side for 30 seconds. It deals 5 damage a hit.

fusions.name: Mosshound
fusions.desc: A bonded hound runs with you, biting enemies within 4 tiles for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds and leaving Rot for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.
